commit.message:
Implement comprehensive HomeNetMon enhancements and fix web server startup

Major Features & Improvements:
- ✅ Fixed HomeNetMon web server startup and auto-start configuration
- ✅ Resolved SQLAlchemy model conflicts and Flask route naming issues
- ✅ Added comprehensive performance monitoring with advanced analytics
- ✅ Implemented interactive chart system with real-time features
- ✅ Enhanced Security Dashboard UX with advanced threat detection
- ✅ Added notification analytics, read receipts, and escalation management
- ✅ Created extensive API suite (mobile, security, performance, analytics)
- ✅ Built complete deployment infrastructure (Docker, K8s, Helm)
- ✅ Added comprehensive test suite with unit and integration tests

Service Configuration:
- Service now binds to 0.0.0.0:5000 (accessible from all interfaces)
- Auto-start on boot enabled and working
- Proper virtual environment configuration
- All background monitoring services operational

Technical Fixes:
- Fixed duplicate SecurityScan and SecurityEvent class definitions
- Fixed reserved 'metadata' field name in PerformanceSnapshot model
- Resolved Flask route conflicts in analytics API
- Updated service configuration to avoid localhost binding
- Added missing dependencies (numpy) and recreated virtual environment

Deployment Ready:
- Complete Docker containerization with multi-stage builds
- Kubernetes manifests with Helm charts
- Production-ready configurations with security hardening
- Comprehensive monitoring and observability features
